Wir verbinden E-Commerce mit Content, Community und Social Commerce und erreichen über Kanäle wie TikTok und Instagram eine breite Community. Unser Sortiment umfasst Tteokbokki, Mandu, Xiaolongbao, Ramen und weitere asiatische Snacks, die wir über unseren Online-Shop sowie Social-Commerce-Kanäle vertreiben. Du stehst gerne vor der Kamera und möchtest lernen, wie TikTok Live-Shopping funktioniert? Dann komm zu MAOMAO! Wir sind ein Berliner Unternehmen für asiatische Lebensmittel mit eigenem Onlineshop und TikTok Shop. In unseren Livestreams stellen wir Produkte vor, probieren Neues und tauschen uns mit unserer Community aus. Dafür suchen wir dich als Unterstützung vor der Kamera und bei allem, was rund um unsere Lives passiert. Produktwissen, Präsentation und Verkaufen im Livestream bringen wir dir Schritt für Schritt bei. Wir bereiten die Auftritte gemeinsam vor, stehen zusammen vor der Kamera und coachen dich dabei. Deine Aufgaben TikTok-Livestreams mitgestalten: Du stehst regelmäßig gemeinsam mit unserem Team vor der Kamera, stellst asiatische Lebensmittel vor und probierst Produkte. Mit unserer Community sprechen: Du greifst Kommentare auf, beantwortest Fragen und kommst mit unseren Zuschauerinnen und Zuschauern ins Gespräch. Lives gemeinsam vorbereiten: Du lernst die Produkte kennen und bereitest mit uns die Produktauswahl, den Ablauf und das Set vor. Nachbereiten und dazulernen: Wir besprechen gemeinsam, was gut funktioniert hat und was wir beim nächsten Mal ausprobieren können. Der Schwerpunkt deiner Arbeit liegt auf unseren Livestreams – du wirst also viel vor der Kamera stehen und aktiv mitmachen. jobs.title: M&A Associate (m/f/d)

Bei Buena bist du das: Du verstehst das Unternehmen, hinterfragst Annahmen, erkennst Risiken und begründest, welchen Preis wir zahlen sollten. Du verantwortest die Due Diligence für Hausverwaltungen, die wir übernehmen möchten: von der ersten Sichtung des Datenraums über die Bewertung und die Präsentation im Investment Committee bis zu den finanziellen und operativen Anlagen für den Kaufvertrag. Wenn das Committee ins Detail geht, kennst du das Unternehmen und kannst deine Empfehlung fundiert begründen. Unser Prozess steht. Jetzt suchen wir jemanden, der die Verantwortung für die Qualität der Analysen übernimmt, die Due Diligence eigenständig steuert und unseren Prozess mit dem Wachstum weiterentwickelt. Über Buena Buena übernimmt Hausverwaltungen und digitalisiert sie mit selbst entwickelter Software. Wir verbinden Akquisitionen, operative Erfahrung und Technologie, um Immobilieneigentum und Verwaltung einfacher zu machen. M&A ist ein zentraler Teil dieser Strategie. Die Unternehmen, die wir kaufen, werden Teil von Buena. Deshalb zählt unser Verständnis ihrer Zahlen, Verträge, Teams und Abläufe weit über den Abschluss einer Transaktion hinaus. Deine Verantwortung Das Unternehmen hinter dem Datenraum verstehen. Du führst Finanzdaten, Verträge, Objektlisten und Mitarbeiterinformationen zusammen. Du erkennst Lücken, gehst Widersprüchen nach und klärst offene Fragen mit den Verkäufern, bis ein belastbares Gesamtbild entsteht. Die Bewertung fundiert herleiten. Du analysierst die wirtschaftliche Entwicklung, arbeitest mit unseren Kaufpreismodellen und prüfst die zugrunde liegenden Annahmen. Du zeigst, was deine Erkenntnisse für den Kaufpreis und die Investitionsentscheidung bedeuten. Deine Ergebnisse im Investment Committee vertreten. Du verdichtest die Due Diligence zu einer klaren Einschätzung von Chancen, Risiken und offenen Fragen und präsentierst sie direkt vor den Entscheidungsträg

Our team brings together care, innovative thinking, and cutting-edge AI medical technology. Our founders launched AMBOSS in 2012 with the goal of creating a tool they wished they had during medical school and clinical practice. Since then, we’ve grown to over 600 employees and are active in over 180 countries - primarily in Germany and the US. Our offices are located in Berlin, Cologne, New York, Cagliari and Cape Town. Want to learn more about our culture? Watch our video to explore what makes us unique. Why can this position be exciting for you? Your work will shape the language that medical students, clinicians, and educators rely on, from exam prep to the point of care. jobs.title: IT Systems Engineer
jobs.description: ABOUT BASETEN Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma, and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F , led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to ship AI products. THE ROLE We’re looking for an IT Engineer to design the systems behind how people at Baseten get access, stay secure, and move through their time here. This role builds the controls and automation that our IT Operations team runs every day across identity, client platforms, SaaS, and cloud access. The goal is a corporate environment that’s secure by default and easy to use: access that’s right from day one, removed when it should be, and provable at any time. RESPONSIBILITIES Strengthen our identity platform with strong authentication, clean access models, and least privilege as the default. Automate the workforce lifecycle so that joining, changing roles, and leaving Baseten are fast, consistent, and need little manual work. Build reliable pipelines for OS updates, patching, and software deployment that keep the fleet current without disrupting people’s work. Connect device health to access decisions, so a compliant device is what earns access to sensitive systems. Recommend identity and security standards for our SaaS and AI tools, and make the secure configuration the easy path for teams adopting new ones. Bring governance to non-human identities (service accounts, API keys, AI agents) and replace long-lived credentials with better options wherever possible. Manage configuration as code across identity and endpoints to reduce drift, so audit readiness comes from the systems themselves instead of a separate workstream.

jobs.title: Agentic Systems Engineer (Digital Services)
jobs.description: Overview We re looking for an Agentic Systems Engineer, to work on systems that haven t existed before. Think of an Agentic Coach that navigates the unpredictability of human biology, or the software architecture behind a fully automated Dark Lab. These aren t chatbots waiting for questions. They re proactive systems that maintain world models, interpret human intent, and intervene before the user knows to ask. These systems create genuine impact for clients tackling complex problems at the forefront of technology. Building them means designing and wiring agent harnesses: layered architectures that span from sensor-edge reasoning to high-level planning, backed by stateful multi-turn reasoning, persistent per-user memory, and robust evaluation pipelines. You ll work in two directions at once. Internally, you ll use the latest AI tools to sharpen how we build, prototype, and ship. Externally, you ll deliver the breakthrough systems our clients deploy, designed to move from prototype to production at pace. There s no single technology stack. You ll work with agents, multi-agent systems, and the latest generative AI tools, but your work will always be grounded in solid software engineering. Expect to build scalable distributed systems in core languages like Python and TypeScript, leveraging frameworks such as NextJS and Pydantic, agent orchestration tools (LangGraph, CrewAI), and protocols like MCP. You ll deploy on cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) using Docker, Kubernetes, and infrastructure-as-code, backed by rigorous CI/CD and observability (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus). Due to the clients we work with, you must be eligible for UK security clearance. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (AppSec)
jobs.description: About us Trigger.dev is the platform for running reliable AI agents and workflows. Developers use it to build, deploy, and scale production systems with built-in tools for orchestration, scheduling, monitoring, and debugging. Our Cloud product is a managed service where we deploy our users’ code and auto-scale from zero to millions of executions. Today, we serve thousands of teams building AI apps and agents, handling hundreds of millions of executions per month. About the role You’ll own security at Trigger.dev: our infrastructure, our app, the runtime that runs our users’ code, and the secrets they trust us with. Some of our customers let their own users run code on Trigger.dev (think coding agents running whatever instructions they’re given). That code must never reach our systems or our customers’ systems. Keeping it contained is a feature we ship, so this is a product engineering role as much as a security one. About half to three quarters of your time will be backend engineering. The rest is hunting for problems and fixing them. When you find something, you own the fix. You’ll set your own priorities and work with others when necessary. We’re looking for an application security (AppSec) engineer who builds: a senior backend engineer who brings a security mindset to everything they ship. What you’ll do Sandbox and runtime security. Design and harden the environments that isolate untrusted user code. This is the core of the role. Security features for customers. Build things like end-to-end encrypted secrets, log redaction, private networking, and runtime hardening. Automated offensive testing. Use AI tools to attack our own systems on a schedule, find weak spots, and fix them. Bring in outside pen testers when it’s worth it. Detection and response. Build monitoring and alerting for suspicious activity, improve our security observability, and lead the response when something needs a look. Vulnerability management. jobs.title: Systems Simulation & Performance Modelling - Member of Technical Staff
jobs.description: About Us We’re living through a Cambrian explosion of intelligence: new models and new chips, each specialised for different tasks, are arriving all at once. The result is a new era for AI, one of radical heterogeneity. Callosum is the Intelligent Systems Company. We believe the next generation of AI won't be defined by any single model or chip, but by intelligent systems in which hardware and intelligence co-evolve. We are building the infrastructure that unifies heterogeneous compute across the full stack. This opens a new axis of scaling intelligence: a dynamic system that tailors itself to what each workload actually needs, whether that's speed, cost, precision, or whatever unit comes next. The last era scaled on a different bet: one bigger model, more of the same chip, more data. That bet is running into structural limits. Frontier models offer extraordinary capability at unsustainable cost, one that today's monolithic infrastructure was never designed to serve. Our founding principle is that intelligence comes from many specialised systems working together, not from any single component. We build the software orchestration layer that co-evolves models, workflows and silicon into one system, delivering inference tailored to every workload, and demonstrating orders-of-magnitude leaps in capability and cost. Because our software spans the full stack, our engineering team works directly with heterogeneous accelerators and frontier silicon, including Cerebras, d-Matrix, Intel, NVIDIA, AMD, Normal Computing, Tenstorrent, GreatSky, and Mixx. We are not stopping at today's chips: each new generation of silicon unlocks algorithms that couldn't run before, and we intend to be first to them, every time. If we get it right, it will belong to everyone building on it - not to any single vendor. Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell. We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought. We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded. jobs.title: Senior Product Owner, Support Platform & AI
jobs.description: About Jimdo We exist to unleash the power of the self-employed - helping solopreneurs and micro-businesses thrive by doing what they're passionate about and removing the complexity of building lasting, successful businesses. Jimdo started in 2007 when three school friends built a website builder in a Northern German farmhouse to help everyone build a presence online. Today, we're a profitable, remote-first company with 220+ people from 50+ nationalities working across 15+ countries. We've helped build over 36 million websites to get online across the world. We're more than just a website builder. We're an AI-powered platform that helps self-employed people actually run and build successful businesses — from getting found online, winning customers and running their business with a peace of mind by knowing exactly what to do next to move forward. At the heart of Jimdo is a strong belief in personalized, data-driven guidance. Our platform combines design, business tools, and an AI-powered core that turns real customer data into clear insights and next steps helping our customers focus on what moves their business forward. Role Overview At Jimdo, we think the best support is the one a customer never needs. When our customers, self-employed people and small business owners, do need help, it should come fast: from self-service and AI first, and from a person when that's what the case needs. We're bringing our support tooling, Zendesk, chatbots and AI work together into one team with one backlog and one roadmap. As Senior Product Owner, you'll lead that team and own the outcome: more questions answered by AI, faster help, lower cost to serve, and customers who still trust us. You'll also shape where this goes next. Over the next couple of years AI will handle more and more first-line support, and you'll decide how the work is split between AI and people, and build the platform around it. The team and who you'll work with You'll report to the Head of Customer Support Servic

jobs.title: Mechanical Design Engineer
jobs.description: WHO WE ARE Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant. Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach. Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions. BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO Shape the architecture of the world’s first commercial fusion power plant – Own system-level decisions that determine how a first-of-a-kind energy technology is designed, integrated, and ultimately deployed at scale. Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges – Work across tightly coupled disciplines (plasma physics, magnets, cryogenics, manufacturing, controls, and more) to resolve critical trade-offs and turn cutting-edge science into a functioning product. Design real hardware with a pragmatic, fast-moving team from all over the world – Combine advanced simulation and systems thinking with a strong execution mindset, focusing on practical engineering solutions that accelerate the path to commercial fusion energy. jobs.description: Join a short, paid project that tests whether AI coding agents work as well on instructions written in the target language as they do in English. Your language skills and technical background decide where you fit. Agents are given a real software engineering task in a code repository, and automated tests check whether they solved it. The code, repositories and tests stay exactly as they are. Only the human-written instructions change language, so the quality of every instruction directly affects the result. About the roles There are two roles on this project. We place you in one of them based on your experience & skillsets. Translator: translate English software engineering task briefs into the target language. You keep every requirement, constraint and success condition, and you leave commands, file paths, API names, code and test conditions exactly as written in English. This role suits people with a stronger technical background, and translation experience is a plus. Reviewer: compare each translation with the English source, check that nothing is missing, added or changed in meaning, correct errors, and log each correction by error type. This role suits people with strong translation, editing or review experience and enough technical familiarity to read code context. Who we are looking for Native or near-native writing in the target language, and strong reading ability in English. Either professional experience in translation, editing, review or technical writing, or a software background combined with excellent writing in the target language Comfort reading technical text. Constructor Tech and Constructor Labs, together with Constructor University, invite you to Student Labs : a 2-month educational research program for BSc and MSc students. AI-native software platforms are one of the fastest-growing fields in tech , and few students get to study one from the inside. Student Labs gives you that chance. UFORCE builds uncrewed vessels, ground robotics and aircraft, autonomy software, and the command-and-control layer that operates them together. Each platform is deployable on its own, and stronger as part of the system. Its product lines include the MAGURA family of uncrewed surface vessels, the NEMESIS family of strike platforms, the LIUT family of ground robotic platforms, and counter-UAS systems. About the role The Senior Engineer, AI / ML — Self-Serve Toolchain will build the end-to-end system that lets customers adapt UFORCE models on their own private data without exposing that data to us. This role spans data processing, foundation-model-assisted labeling, human-in-the-loop QA, active learning, training, evaluation, and model promotion . You will turn an in-flight principal-led capability into a repeatable toolchain that non-expert customers can run safely on-site. What you’ll do Own the ML adaptation pipeline from raw customer data to trained, evaluated, deployable models. Build foundation-model-assisted labeling workflows using tools such as SAM-2 , Grounding DINO , open-vocabulary models, LLM steering, and human review. Design self-serve operator workflows using yes/no/maybe feedback and natural-language corrections. Create versioned datasets with lineage, data cards, label provenance, class distributions, and known gaps. Build QA methods that catch systematic pseudo-label errors, missing annotations, and long-tail data gaps. Develop active-learning loops that prioritize the highest-value frames for limited operator review. Build reproducible train/eval pipelines with experiment tracking, model packaging, and promotion gates. You’ll lead the technical development of this product. The role is about 80% hands-on building and 20% leading, and it grows with the platform into areas beyond billing. jobs.description: Qui sommes-nous ? Doctolib est une entreprise B Corp engagée à construire ensemble la santé dont nous rêvons tous. Avec 2 900 collaborateurs en France, en Allemagne, en Italie et aux Pays-Bas, nous accompagnons plus de 420 000 professionnels de santé et 90 millions de patients, transformant l'accès aux soins et la prise en charge à travers l'Europe. Artefact est une société de conseil et d ingénierie française spécialisée en data et IA, et leader en Europe, qui depuis plus de 10 ans est spécialisée dans la conception et le déploiement de technologies d’intelligence artificielle et de solutions data-driven. Basé à Paris, nous sommes aujourd’hui présents dans 27 pays sur tous les continents et comptons 2500 collaborateurs.  Notre mission est d’aider les entreprises à exploiter tout le potentiel de l’IA et de la data en développant des solutions sur-mesure adaptées à leurs enjeux métiers. En tant que pionniers dans ce domaine, nous allions expertise technologique et excellence opérationnelle, en collaborant avec les plus grands acteurs du marché. Nos clients couvrent tous les secteurs clés de l’économie – industrie, retail, luxe, grande consommation, santé, finance – et incluent des grands groupes internationaux.  En tant que Stagiaire Data Consultant , tu seras pleinement intégré(e) à une équipe de consultants. Ton rôle sera d assister nos clients dans l élaboration et la mise en œuvre de leur stratégie data, de la phase d idéation jusqu à l implémentation. Tes missions pourront inclure : Cadrage / gestion des projets : interview clients et partenaires, mise en place de workshops, préparation des uses cases… Construction de roadmaps, d’analyses data-driven avec l’équipe projet et conception d infrastructures en collaboration avec nos experts  Orchestration du bon déroulement du projet, en appliquant le cas échéant les méthodes agiles (sprints planning et reviews, backlog refinement, démos…)  Veille technologique et sectorielle : rester à l affût des dernières tendances en matière de data et d intelligence artificielle pour proposer des solutions innovantes. Communication : Préparer des présentations et des supports de communication pour les comités de direction et les équipes clientes. Processus de recrutement  Étape 1 : Entretien RH avec notre chargée de recrutement, An

jobs.title: Intern Data Analyst - Paris
jobs.description: Qui sommes-nous ? Fondée en 2014, Artefact est une société française de services autour de la data, spécialisée dans le conseil en IA, transformation data et en data & digital marketing. L’approche unique d’Artefact, qui fait le pont entre la donnée et le business, permet à nos clients d’atteindre leurs objectifs business de façon dédiée et efficace. Nos 2500 collaborateurs répartis dans 27 bureaux à travers le monde allient leurs compétences pluridisciplinaires au profit de l’innovation business des entreprises. La mission des Artefactors ? Transformer la data de nos clients en impact business. Dans ce sens, nous collaborons avec plus de 1000 clients, leaders de leurs industries (Orange, Carrefour, Samsung, AccorHotels, L’Oréal, LVMH, Decathlon) et sommes partenaires privilégiés de Google (GMP/GCP), AWS ainsi que Microsoft Azure. En tant que stagiaire Data Analyst, tu seras intégré(e) à une équipe travaillant étroitement avec des consultants / data scientists et tu participeras à des missions ayant un impact réel pour les clients. Tes missions pourront inclure : Collecter, nettoyer, préparer les données à partir de sources diverses (bases de données internes, API, logs, etc.). Explorer et analyser les données pour identifier tendances, anomalies, corrélations, patterns utiles. Participer à la conception et réalisation de dashboards / reportings sous outils de data visualisation (ex. Tableau, PowerBI, ou outils internes) pour présenter les résultats aux équipes ou aux clients. Contribuer à la définition de KPI pertinents selon les objectifs métier. Travailler en collaboration avec les équipes métier (marketing, produit, etc.) pour bien comprendre leurs besoins et transformer ces besoins en analyses exploitables. Aider à automatiser certains processus de reporting ou analyses simples. Documenter tes travaux, partager les résultats et les apprentissages au sein de l’équipe, proposer des améliorations ou de nouvelles approches quand c’est possible. Profil recherché

jobs.title: CDI - AI Designer  Motion & Génératif  - Artefact 3000 - Paris
jobs.description: QUI SOMMES-NOUS  Artefact 3000 est l’agence créative intégrée d’Artefact qui combine le talent créatif au savoir-faire data & IA. L’agence puise son inspiration dans le réel et les insights précis pour concevoir des idées qui résonnent et marquent les esprits sur tous les terrains de jeu créatifs, de l’IA aux médias intemporels.  Basée à Paris, Artefact 3000 compte 65 collaborateurs et accompagne ses clients dans la définition de leur stratégie de communication, la conception et le déploiement de campagnes intégrées, l’animation des réseaux sociaux, et la production digitale (contenus, expériences digitales, sites web). MISSIONS Dans ce rôle, tu es en charge de la production de contenus visuels et vidéo en IA générative , sous la direction d un créatif tech senior et en collaboration direct avec un autre créatif. La majorité de ton activité consiste à exécuter des briefs créatifs avec des outils IA, en garantissant la qualité et la cohérence des livrables finaux. Production IA (cœur du poste) Produire des contenus image et vidéo avec des outils IA génératifs (Midjourney, Runway, Kling, Higgsfield,, etc.) selon des briefs créatifs précis. Assurer la post-production et l intégration des assets IA dans des livrables finaux (montage, compositing, motion). Motion design & exécution créative Produire des contenus vidéo en motion design (After Effects, Premiere Pro). Décliner des concepts visuels validés sur les formats de campagne 360 (social, display, film digital, OOH). Contribuer à l élaboration de moodboards et key visuals en amont de production. PROFIL Expérience Diplômé(e) d une école de Design (design graphique ou motion design) ou avec une première expérience professionnelle en agence.  Un portfolio avec des productions IA concrètes est obligatoire ; les candidatures sans livrables IA ne seront pas examinées. Compétences techniques indispensables Maîtrise indispensable de la Suite Adobe : After Effects, Premiere Pro, Photoshop et Illustrator

jobs.title: Teamleiter Last Mile Logistik (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Kurz und Knapp   Du liebst die tägliche Abwechslung, siehst dich als (zukünftige) Führungskraft, um dein Team zum Erfolg zu führen, und bist bereit für eine neue Herausforderung in der Logistik? Dann bist du bei Picnic genau richtig! Denn wir suchen nach einer Teamleitung für unseren Last Mile Standort (Hub) in München. Die Hubs werden mit unseren bereits fertig kommissionierten Waren aus dem Zentrallager (Fulfillment Center) beliefert und sind als Verteilzentrum die letzte Station unserer Logistikkette, bevor die Einkäufe beim Kunden auf dem Küchentisch landen.   Das erwartet dich    Teamführung: Stelle dein Team ein und coache es zum Erfolg. Du kannst auch tolle Events planen, um den Zusammenhalt weiter zu stärken. Entwicklung zur Führungskraft: Du managst nicht nur die Schichtpläne, sondern übernimmst die Einarbeitung und Entwicklung der Runner (Fahrer) in einem unserer Hubs, und sorgst so dafür, dass alles rund läuft. Liefermanagement: Du übernimmst die Verantwortung, wenn die Lkw mit frischen Waren ankommen, und sorgst dafür, dass alles passt! Und wenn etwas fehlt, organisierst du blitzschnell Nachlieferungen – du behältst immer den Überblick über doe Logistik in deinem Standort. Prozessmanagement: Du hältst den Betrieb am Laufen durch einen kontinuierlich den Fokus auf unsere betrieblichen Kennzahlen (KPIs) und garantierst, dass alles sicher und wie am Schnürchen läuft, ganz nach unserem Motto: “Safety First”. Teamwork: Im engen Austausch mit dem Customer-Success Team, unserem Zentrallager (Fulfillment Center) und anderen Hubs machst du unsere Kunden glücklich. Pünktliche Abfahrten: Dank dir sind unsere Fahrer immer pünktlich unterwegs zu unseren Kunden, damit wir unser versprochenes Zeitfenster einhalten können. Bringe deine Ideen ein : Von der Koordination der Reparatur unserer Elektrofahrzeuge über die Gestaltung des Hub Layouts bis hin zur Rekrutierung unserer Runner - deine Ideen tragen dazu bei, dass wir gemeinsam weiter wachsen könne

jobs.description: about us Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world. For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses. AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years. At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience. But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. This will become one of the most important software categories of the next decade, and we intend to win it. We are a small, AI-pilled team that likes to solve hard problems. Be it engineering, product, or GTM - we build, experiment, and move fast, while heavily leveraging the capabilities of AI models. All of us like to challenge ourselves and take real ownership over what we do, all while still staying humble and keeping a low-ego culture. Check out our principles to see how we work. mission As Workplace & People Operations Manager at telli, you own the environment our team does its best work in. jobs.title: Tech Lead / CTO (m/w/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Tax advisory has everything automation needs: structured data, recurring work, clear rules. Yet the profession never made the leap, because recurring does not mean uniform. Every case has its own twist, and the law keeps moving. Reasoning resolves exactly this variance. That is why the window is open now. The model is no longer the scarce part. Expert knowledge and real case data are, and AI labs pay a premium for exactly this. Vogel holds what no AI-native player has: decades of accounting data, edge cases and judgment calls from several thousand mid-sized companies, audited and closed. It never leaves the house, and it becomes the edge of what you build. The market is being reordered: four in ten tax advisors in Germany leave the profession within ten years, and many of their firms will find no successor. Vogel acquires established advisory firms and develops them further, and every acquisition adds to that base. We have already produced our own annual financial statements with AI. Today, that is one person with a tool. Turning it into a capability of the whole company is the job. You own the technology that makes Vogel AI-first: the data layer above DATEV, the agent infrastructure on top, and the control layer without which nothing in this profession may go live. You decide the architecture and the stack of what we build. What it does and in which order is decided together with Operations and Moritz Vogel in the role of chief product officer, close to the advisors who use it; you shape it with them. You report to and work directly with Moritz Vogel. What you'll do Architecture above DATEV Build the data layer above DATEV. DATEV stays the system of record (for now); the value is created in the layer above it, designed to outlive the system beneath. Choose and build the agent infrastructure: framework, orchestration, versioning, observability. You answer these questions with code, not with a slide deck. jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Search Features & APIs (SABR)
jobs.description: About us Launched in 2019, Constructor is an AI-first e-commerce search and discovery platform that helps shoppers find the right products at the right time and enables leading global e-commerce brands to drive meaningful revenue and conversion gains. About the team The SABR team owns the top layer of request processing for product discovery. We own the service that first receives product discovery requests (autocomplete, search, browse & recommendations) & executes the entire business logic that drives product discovery. That service also functions as a gateway to parse incoming user requests, orchestrate calls across the internal services that do the ranking and retrieval, interpret their responses, and assemble the final response the customer sees. We also own the public configuration APIs customers use to control how discovery behaves, and the MCP layer that exposes all of it to AI agents. Our team owns both platform & product components: Because of the positioning of our services, we take part in every architectural decision of our core product offering. At the same time, our goals are heavily influenced by direct customer feedback, because all product discovery-related features are either implemented in or integrated with our services. All of our services are public APIs, so interface design and backward compatibility are a constant part of the job. But most of our attention goes to keeping them fast and up: we serve up to 15k RPS, fan out to many internal services on every request, and are expected to stay available and degrade gracefully when any of them fails or slows down. The work is distributed systems in practice rather than in theory: request orchestration, failure isolation, caching, latency budgets, capacity planning, and the observability to know what is actually happening in production. jobs.title: Senior Buchhalter - Finanz- & Lohnbuchhaltung (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Hier bei CloudFactory haben wir eine klare Mission. Wir wollen das Potenzial der künstlichen Intelligenz erschließen, um weltweit positive Veränderungen zu bewirken. Durch die Kombination aus fortschrittlicher Technologie und einem globalen Netzwerk talentierter Menschen machen wir ungenutzte Daten nutzbar und schaffen so weltweit echten Mehrwert im großen Maßstab. Wir sind mehr als nur ein Arbeitsplatz: Wir sind eine globale Gemeinschaft, die auf starken Beziehungen und der Überzeugung basiert, dass sinnvolle Arbeit Leben verändert. jobs.description: About Electra Air travel is about to become something more: more direct, more accessible, and more connected to the places where people live, work and want to be. Every day in the U.S., people make 35 million trips of 50–500 miles, stuck in traffic or routed through crowded hubs. Chances are, you ve been one of them. At Electra, we re changing that with the EL9, a nine-passenger, hybrid-electric aircraft that takes off and lands in just 150 feet. Our Ultra Short technology opens up thousands of new places to fly, beyond conventional runways, congested airports and long drives. We re backed by Lockheed Martin, Honeywell and Safran. Operators worldwide have signed intent-to-purchase agreements for the first 2,200 aircraft we produce, and we re moving toward first test flights in 2027. Getting a new kind of aircraft airborne takes more than ambition. It takes our kind of bold: people who think big while working in the real world. Who move ideas into action and collaborate without silos. Who put people first and make room at the table for everyone. Who challenge one another without diminishing one another. Sound like you? Then look beyond what you thought were your own limits, and help us take flight beyond runways. The Role Electra seeks an experienced Program Manager to lead the planning and execution of a European tour for Electra s EL2 technology demonstrator aircraft. This role will serve as the primary team lead for the EL2 program, partnering closely with engineering, flight test, government and commercial stakeholders, and company leadership to ensure the tour achieves its strategic objectives safely, on schedule, and within budget. jobs.title: Prevention Analyst - Pentesting
jobs.description: Prevention Analyst - Pentesting About this role We are looking for a Prevention Analyst - Pentester, to join our Prevention track. An attacker does not look at one server in isolation. They look at everything a company exposes to the internet and work out where to start. You will do the same for our clients, taking the attacker’s view of their external attack surface, seeing what an attacker sees, and doing what an attacker would do next. That means reading the story behind an attack surface. A forgotten subdomain, an old login portal, and a misconfigured mail server may each look minor on their own. Together they can show how an organisation has grown, where its blind spots are, and where someone could get in. When you find a potential weak point, you dig into it technically to find out how far an attacker could actually go. This is not a classic penetration testing role. The deep dive draws on pentest methodology and expertise, but it is not a full pentest, and you will not spend your weeks writing long reports. We focus on finding the high impact vulnerabilities that need attention now and getting them to the client in a form they can act on. This is for someone with hands on pentesting experience who wants to work across many customer environments, sharpen their attacker mindset, and grow into owning complex prevention engagements end to end. What you will do Assess clients’ external attack surface as a whole, from the attacker’s perspective. Identify gaps and weaknesses across the surface, not just within a single asset, and work out how they connect. Run technical deep dives into potential weak points to establish how far an attacker could get in practice. Separate what needs fixing now from what does not, and focus on high and critical findings with immediate impact. Mapbox is the only platform that equips organizations with the full set of tools to power the navigation of people, packages, and vehicles everywhere. Our work happens at the edge, supporting location frequencies up to 10Hz and ensuring a seamless experience even in tunnels or dense urban canyons. As AI becomes embedded in modern engineering workflows, we value engineers who can thoughtfully integrate AI into design, development, and decision-making. As our People Operations Manager, you'll work directly with the founders and our Talent & People Manager to scale our team from ~30 to 100+ people over the next two years. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role at the intersection of compliance, process design, and employee experience. What you'll own Employment & legal: End-to-end management of employment contracts, work permits, and visa processes in Germany and internationally, including EOR arrangements Payroll: Running and overseeing monthly payroll, ensuring accuracy and compliance across entities Benefits: Managing our existing benefits stack and proactively identifying, proposing, and implementing new offerings as we scale Team culture: Planning and coordinating team events and off-sites, both locally and abroad Office operations: Acting as the point of contact for our coworking space and handling day-to-day operational needs HR processes & compliance: Designing, documenting, and improving people processes as we grow, with a strong eye on German labor law and cross-border compliance topics Room to grow Depending on your interests and background, there's space to own more: Onboarding & offboarding: Design and iterate the full employee lifecycle experience as we scale HRIS & tooling: Own the evaluation and rollout of our HR system of record People analytics: Build lightweight reporting on headcount, attrition, and hiring velocity to support decision-making Learning & development: Lay the groundwork for how Deltia invests in its people as the team matures What we're looking for 2-4 years in People Ops, HR, or a closely related role, ideally in a fast-growing startup Solid understanding of German employment law; experience with international hiring or EORs is a plus Structured, hands-on, and comfortable operating with limited oversight Fluent in English; German is a strong plus Start ASAP in Berlin - Hybrid #LI

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer - Edgy & System (m/f/d)
jobs.description: DevOps Engineer - Edgy & System Our AI analyses real production lines through cameras and edge devices in customer factories. We’re looking for a DevOps Engineer who understands how systems work underneath, from the OS and network up to the cloud, and who will own the software on our growing device fleet and the infrastructure that runs it. What you'll do Own the software on our edge fleet once a device is online: components, configuration, and OS, kernel and GPU driver updates. Build the release path to devices: CI/CD, canary, staged rollouts and rollback over unreliable factory networks. Run fleet monitoring and alerting that catches failing devices and cameras before customers notice; decide whether a fault is software or hardware. Debug hard problems across the stack (processes, memory, disk, network, GPU) and fix root causes, not symptoms. Own our cloud infrastructure in Terraform, including the central systems we use to manage the edge fleet (AWS). Work closely with our Installations team, who set up devices and networks on site. You are 8-10 years in platform, infrastructure, SRE or systems roles. Strong OS fundamentals: processes, memory, file systems, boot, services. You can debug a Linux machine from the shell. Solid networking: TCP/IP, DNS, routing, VPN, firewalls. Experienced with automation and infrastructure as code (Terraform a must, Ansible or similar) and CI/CD. Comfortable with containers and AWS. Methodical and curious: you want to know why something broke, not just make it work again. Nice to have Have run a fleet of remote, on-prem or edge machines (IoT, retail, telecom). AWS IoT Greengrass or similar device management. NVIDIA GPUs or Jetson: drivers, CUDA. Unattended installs or OS images (PXE, cloud-init, ...). Kubernetes in production. Video, camera or ML inference workloads. Why this role matters You'll keep our systems running smoothly and help the team ship with confidence. jobs.title: Business Development Representative — VIE  Germany
jobs.description: About Alta Ares Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them. Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia. Founded in 2024, we have grown to 90 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development. Role & Mission This VIE is Alta Ares' commercial entry point in Germany — the largest defence market in Europe and one undergoing the most significant defence industrial expansion since reunification. Based in Munich, at the heart of Germany's defence industrial ecosystem (Rheinmetall, Hensoldt, KNDS, ESG, MTU), you will support and drive Alta Ares' early-stage commercial development with German primes and institutional contacts. You will map the ecosystem, build first-contact relationships, and support the Account Manager Germany in converting opportunities into pipeline. Germany's Zeitenwende is real, budgets are moving fast, and the demand for AI and C-UAS capabilities is accelerating. You will be on the ground at the right moment. 1. Market Mapping & Opportunity Identification Map Germany's defence industrial landscape: primes, systems integrators, procurement bodies (BAAINBw, Cyber Innovation Hub der Bundeswehr), and innovation initiatives ( dtec.bw , IDEaS-equivalent) Identify partnership and integration opportunities aligned with Alta Ares' product suite: ISR, C-UAS, AI autonomy Track German defence policy, Bundeswehr procurement priorities, and Zeitenwende investment programmes Produce regular market intelligence reports for the Account Manager Germany and Paris leadership team 2. jobs.description: 🎤 Why voize? Because we're more than just a job! At voize, we believe the greatest gift to frontline workers is time - time to care, connect, and be present. Our mission is backed with a $50M Series A funding led by Balderton Capital, with support from HV Capital, Y Combinator and other leading VCs. Today, 2,000+ facilities trust voize, and over 200,000 users rely on our AI companion to ease their daily workload. What makes this role unique is the level of ownership and impact. You’ll work in small, highly collaborative product teams where design decisions meaningfully shape product direction. From discovery through rollout, you’ll stay hands-on through implementation and iteration, shipping work that is not just thoughtful, but truly impactful! 🚀 Your Daily Business You’ll work close to the realities of frontline care . This means spending time with users, understanding real workflows, and turning complex, messy situations into clear, usable product experiences. Own a core product area. Shape and evolve its design direction over time. Design the full flow, not individual screens. Map end-to-end journeys, prototype interactions, and craft production-ready UI that holds up in high-pressure environments. Go where the work happens. Join

jobs.description: About Us Base360.ai is the AI operating system for short-term rental businesses, helping property managers run their operations on autopilot. Born out of The Flex, a short-term rental operator that scaled to an eight-figure business using its own software, Base360.ai is now launching as a standalone platform for short-term rental operators worldwide. We bring reservations, guest communication, pricing, payments, cleaning, maintenance, and reporting into one platform—helping operators automate manual work, reduce costs, increase revenue, and scale their portfolios. We're looking for an ambitious Senior Full-Stack Product Engineer who wants to turn real customer problems into intuitive, reliable software. You'll work closely with founders, designers, and operators to identify what matters, build solutions, and improve them based on how people use them. If you enjoy owning the full journey from customer problem to shipped product—and you're excited by AI, automation, and short-term rentals—we want to meet you. What You'll Build As a Senior Full-Stack Product Engineer, you'll help shape and scale Base360.ai across the entire short-term rental lifecycle. You'll build customer-facing features, operational dashboards, automation engines, AI-powered workflows, and integrations that help property managers grow without increasing their workload at the same rate. Your work will connect what users see with the systems behind it—from a guest’s check-in experience to the workflows coordinating reservations, cleaning, payments, and owner reporting. jobs.description: Du liebst persönlichen Kundenkontakt. Bei uns verbindest du ihn mit internationalen Aufgaben und der Chance, beruflich weiterzukommen. Wir sind Akademis, eine mehrfach ausgezeichnete Bildungsberatung. Wir helfen Familien, das passende Internat im Ausland für ihr Kind zu finden, und begleiten sie bei den nächsten Schritten. Für unser neues Büro in Berlin-Frohnau suchen wir jemanden, der gerne telefoniert, aufmerksam zuhört und Freude daran hat, sich persönlich um Menschen zu kümmern. Unsere Familien vertrauen uns eine wichtige Entscheidung an. Sie schätzen eine Ansprechperson, die ihre Wünsche kennt, verständlich erklärt und zuverlässig nachfasst. Genau das lieben wir an unserer Arbeit: wenn aus einem ersten Gespräch eine vertraute Zusammenarbeit wird und Eltern wissen, dass sie sich auf uns verlassen können. Vielleicht arbeitest du bisher in der Hotellerie, in der Gästebetreuung oder im Kundenservice und möchtest deine Erfahrung in einem neuen Umfeld einsetzen. Bei uns bist du als Quereinsteiger herzlich willkommen. Noch wichtiger als ein perfekter Lebenslauf sind uns deine Persönlichkeit, deine Verlässlichkeit und deine Freude daran, Familien und junge Menschen zu begleiten. Du möchtest dich einbringen und beruflich weiterkommen? Wir arbeiten dich persönlich ein und unterstützen dich dabei, deine eigenen Familien zunehmend selbstständig zu betreuen. In unserem kleinen Team kannst du Abläufe mitgestalten und mehr Verantwortung übernehmen. LogicSteel is ons cloud-based software platform voor de staalverwerkende industrie. Middels LogicSteel wordt de ontwerpfase, werkvoorbereiding en productie naadloos met elkaar verbonden. Wat kunnen klanten uit LogicSteel halen? Als senior medewerker Financiële Administratie ben je verantwoordelijk voor een zorgvuldige uitvoering en bewaking van diverse financiële administratieve processen. jobs.title: Junior Tester
jobs.description: Ben jij nieuwsgierig naar hoe software werkt en vind je het leuk om uit te zoeken of alles doet wat het zou moeten doen? Heb je oog voor detail, stel je graag kritische vragen en krijg je energie van het vinden van verbeterpunten? Dan is deze functie als Junior Tester precies wat je zoekt! Als tester speel je een belangrijke rol in de kwaliteit van software. Je onderzoekt applicaties, voert testen uit en kijkt kritisch naar de werking ervan. Kom je iets tegen wat niet klopt? Dan analyseer je wat er aan de hand is en zorg je ervoor dat jouw bevindingen duidelijk bij de juiste mensen terechtkomen. Je hoeft nog geen ervaring te hebben als tester. We vinden het vooral belangrijk dat je leergierig, analytisch en nauwkeurig bent en graag wilt ontdekken hoe je software steeds beter kunt maken. Wat ga je doen als Junior Tester? Als Junior Tester houd je je bezig met het controleren en beoordelen van de werking en kwaliteit van applicaties en systemen. Je werkt samen met ontwikkelaars, analisten en andere betrokken collega's om ervoor te zorgen dat software goed functioneert en voldoet aan de verwachtingen. Je leert stap voor stap hoe je verschillende soorten testen uitvoert en hoe je bevindingen op een duidelijke manier rapporteert. Concreet zijn jouw werkzaamheden: Opstellen van testscenario's Uitvoeren van testgevallen Controleren of applicaties werken zoals bedoeld Signaleren van fouten, afwijkingen en verbeterpunten Analyseren van testresultaten en bevindingen Registreren en duidelijk communiceren van bevindingen Samenwerken met developers, analisten en andere stakeholders Meedenken over de kwaliteit en betrouwbaarheid van software Leren werken met verschillende testmethodieken en tools Je krijgt gedurende het traineeship de ruimte om praktijkervaring op te doen en steeds meer verantwoordelijkheid te nemen. jobs.title: Recruitment Manager
jobs.description: Wil jij op operationeel niveau bouwen aan de mensen die het onderwijs van duizenden leerlingen versterken? Als Resource Manager bij Lyceo in Leiden krijg je een sleutelpositie binnen een landelijke marktleider die volop groeit. Een baan met directe impact, veel verantwoordelijkheid en volop ruimte om recruitment en capaciteitsmanagement verder te professionaliseren. Taken Maak het verschil als Recruitment Manager Als Resource Manager zorg je ervoor dat Lyceo nu en in de toekomst beschikt over de juiste begeleiders om scholen en leerlingen tijdig te ondersteunen. Je bent eindverantwoordelijk voor hun beschikbaarheid, kwaliteit en inzetbaarheid. Je maakt deel uit van het MT en rapporteert rechtstreeks aan de directie van Lyceo. Met ondersteuning van het datateam bepaal je welke begeleiders waar en wanneer nodig zijn. Op basis daarvan laat je gerichte recruitmentacties uitvoeren en geef je richting aan selectie, matching en onboarding. Met KPI’s bewaak je de instroom, retentie, vervulling en doorlooptijden en stuur je gericht bij. Daarnaast optimaliseer je processen en geef je leiding aan een team met onder andere een Recruiter en een Coördinator Matching en Onboarding. Samen met de Operationeel Manager zorg je voor voldoende geschikte mensen en een succesvolle uitvoering van alle onderwijsprojecten. jobs.title: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks
jobs.description: We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want. You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models. Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week. How it works Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another. Requirements 2+ years of professional software engineering Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code) Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++ Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing Regular use of an AI coding tool Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words At least 10 hours a week, starting now A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines) Nice to have Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure Experience building agent
